name: DeepSeek-V3
description: A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters (37B activated per token). While not exclusively a coding model, DeepSeek-V3 includes strong code generation capabilities through the DeepSeek-Coder series. The model is open-source and claimed to be 3x faster than V2 with SOTA performance, achieving results that surpass Llama 3.1 405B in benchmarks.
